comment: S4 memory corpus (FR27, A12): native `lope memory` subcommands (`stats`, `search`, `file`, `hotspots`, `forget`, `gates`) vs Python Lope.

cases.name: memory-stats-seeded
cases.setup_py:
from lope.memory import open_memory
from lope.findings import ConsensusFinding, ConsensusLevel
s = open_memory()
f = ConsensusFinding(message='SQL injection in login', file='src/auth.py', line=42, severity='high', category='security', confidence_max=0.9, confidence_avg=0.9, consensus_score=0.9, consensus_level=ConsensusLevel.CONFIRMED, agreement_count=2, total_validators=2, agreement_ratio=1.0, detected_by=['claude','codex'], evidence={'claude':'line 42'})
s.store_review_session(task='lope review src/auth.py', focus='security', target_path='src/auth.py', validators=['claude','codex'], findings=[f])
s.store_review_session(task='lope review src/auth.py', focus='security', target_path='src/auth.py', validators=['claude','codex'], findings=[f])
s.store_gate_session(task='gate check', mode='check', baseline_path='.lope/baseline.json', passed=True, gate_count=2, failed_count=0, payload={'ok': True})
